results.rationale: Forward delivery obligation is generally supported by adjacent digital-portal experience (mobile banking) but the evidence does not directly show an insurance policyholder self-service portal with all listed functions.

UX/UI and accessible responsive front-end delivery is a commitment, but provided capability records are not clearly UX/UI-focused, so support is only indirect via general software delivery maturity (CMMI/PMP).
Providing a CMS corporate website is a commitment and is plausibly within our broader software delivery capability, but the cited projects do not explicitly demonstrate prior CMS website delivery.
Secure portal delivery with authentication and role-based access is well supported by cybersecurity track record and ISO 27001 capability.
Integration with an existing core system via APIs is credibly supported by ERP implementation experience which typically includes system integrations.
Online payment gateway integration is credibly supported by mobile banking deployments where payment integrations are core functionality.
Deploying the solution into the Corporation’s cloud environment is supported by multiple cloud infrastructure deployments including for government clients.
One-year warranty support with defined response times is supported by our stated in-country support model with 24–48h response SLAs and ability to commit to warranty terms.
